fix_subject: Fix geometry TextWriter corrupting coordinates in scientific notation

labels.summary: The geometry TextWriter's trailing-zero removal stripped the last '0' of scientific-notation numbers such as 1e+20 (yielding 1e+2), corrupting GEOMETRY::VARCHAR output for very large or very small coordinates; the fix skips that removal when an exponent is present.
